conditions.description: Pin the immutable Starlight #103 human-review evidence bundle.

notes: Template only, owned by issue #103. Fill reviewer fields and set decision to approved | approved_with_conditions | rejected. Keep the review-bundle-v1 condition unchanged: it cryptographically binds this decision to the exact candidate, merge report, CI gates, redistribution inventory, validation artifact manifest, release-candidate-v1.toml, and runtime-assets-v1.toml reviewed by the human. Additional approved_with_conditions entries must be structured machine-verifiable conditions; free-text conditions block automatic promotion. Supported verifiers: repository_file_sha256, candidate_sha256, runtime_map_sha256, inventory_sha256. Do not change candidate_sha256 or the review-bundle pin unless a new frozen review bundle is deliberately published before any human signs.
